# hestiacp_mail_forward (Resource)

Manages an email forward for a HestiaCP mail account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) Mailbox name (part before the @).
- `domain` (String) Mail domain.
- `forward` (String) Email address to forward to.

### Optional

- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
